name: -6 AN to 11/16-18 Inverted Flare Adapter
title: -6 AN to 11/16-18 Inverted Flare Adapter
description:
The -6 AN to 11/16-18 Inverted Flare Adapter is engineered for demanding high-performance automotive fluid systems. ColorFittings Inverted Flare Adapters are precision-engineered to connect AN flare fittings to inverted flare ports, providing a secure, leak-free solution for brake, fuel, oil, and power steering plumbing systems.

Technical Specifications:
• Origin: Precision CNC-machined in the USA.
• Material & Finish: 6061-T6 Billet Aluminum with an anodized finish for maximum corrosion resistance.
